named_subject: a tornado funnel: an inverted cone with a looping swirl at the top
action: The funnel stays in place and sways slightly, its tip drifting left and right while the rim tilts a little, against fixed cloud and ground lines.
identity_gap: The animated funnel keeps the doodle's construction (loop rim, open swirl tail, kinked left side, long right side) but parts of the rim turn grey in some frames, so the drawing loses strokes the doodle has.
notes: The film shows a large tornado that barely moves while the camera drifts slightly, and the animation matches that near-stillness, but the motion is so small that it reads as jitter rather than a rotating or advancing funnel. The change that would help most is keeping all rim strokes black in every frame (frames 4, 12, 14 and 16 drop part of the rim and right side to grey) and adding a steady rotation of the top swirl so the movement reads as one continuous action.
